applicabilityBasis.summary: YieldFi yUSD is a strategy-vault certificate whose redemption value tracks series net asset value after liabilities and losses. The token terms permit USDC or fiat bank-transfer settlement at variable NAV; the reviewed terms establish no obligation to repay a fixed amount of monetary value.

genius.notes: Assessment concerns YieldFi yUSD, not its USDC accounting/deposit parent. Current yUSD and general terms use YieldFi as issuer/operator and BVI governing law but do not verify an exact incorporated legal issuer; issuerEntity and issuerDomicile are omitted. No legally established securities exclusion is asserted. Documentation permits loss and limited recourse, consistent with a variable-value vault position.
